Market today: Geopolitical tensions and rising oil prices are the main drivers, pushing yields higher. This is a tough environment for growth names, especially leveraged ones like yours.

Your holdings: SOXL is a big loser (-58.66%) and flagged for attention. QQQ (-0.91%), SMH (-14.35%), and QQQI (-4.19%) are also flagged for trimming. CRWD (19.48%) and SPY (3.73%) are holding up. SPAL (-37.73%) is a new, leveraged position needing close watching.

Watch: Keep an eye on the 10-year Treasury yield and oil prices.

Bottom line: The macro environment is challenging for your concentrated tech/chip book, especially with leverage.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming exposure given the leveraged decay and negative PnL.
SPAL: Monitor closely; leveraged ETFs decay and can move fast.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
